action_items: Fix preview CORS origin mapping so Access-Control-Allow-Origin matches https://overlay-ui-kit.preview.emergentagent.com for POST preflight requests.
Retest assistant session/chat UI after CORS fix (streaming, follow-up memory, add-to-cart cards).
Retest cart coupon apply and checkout order creation after CORS fix.

Decide whether legacy reel-burger-webm key should be restored or old test expectation retired.
critical_code_review_comments: Frontend API base selection (Constants.expoConfig?.extra?.backendUrl precedence) plus preview ingress CORS policy appears inconsistent with public preview origin.
CORS headers observed via OPTIONS return a different cluster-origin domain, causing browser-side POST failures despite backend endpoint health.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Verified /tmp/motion-assets-v2.log import completion.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Start with CORS verification from public origin using OPTIONS on /api/assistant/sessions, /api/coupons/apply, /api/orders. GET routes and managed v2 media keys are healthy. Long-press vs quick tap behavior is correct from Home.
rca_of_issue: Reproduced in Playwright console and curl preflight. OPTIONS requests to /api/orders and /api/assistant/sessions from Origin https://overlay-ui-kit.preview.emergentagent.com return Access-Control-Allow-Origin set to a different cluster domain (not request origin). Browser blocks subsequent POSTs, breaking assistant UI, coupon apply, and checkout order placement.
